description: Users property view item with a KNOWNFOLDERID and an embedded property store
notes: Signature 0x23FEBBEE is the one whose identifier is a KNOWNFOLDERID. The property store that follows is byte-identical in structure to a .lnk PropertyStoreDataBlock payload -- MS-PROPSTORE either way -- but rclip-idlist keeps it as raw bytes rather than depending on rclip-shell-link.
